data.name: IntroductionDescription
data.value: ImoSphere is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

data.name: IntroductionCompliance
data.value: By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. We are committed to complying with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Portuguese data protection legislation.

data.name: KeyPoint1
data.value: We only collect information necessary for our services

data.name: KeyPoint2
data.value: Your data is protected with industry-standard security

data.name: KeyPoint3
data.value: You have full control over your personal information

data.name: KeyPoint4
data.value: We never sell your personal data to third parties

data.value: We use your information for the following purposes:

data.name: ServiceProvisionDescription
data.value: To provide and maintain our real estate services, including property searches, listings, and user accounts.

data.name: CommunicationDescription
data.value: To send updates, notifications, and respond to your inquiries and support requests.

data.name: AnalyticsDescription
data.value: To analyze usage patterns, improve our services, and develop new features.

data.name: SecurityDescription
data.value: To protect against fraud, abuse, and ensure the security of our platform and users.

data.name: InformationSharingDescription
data.value: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

data.name: WithYourConsentDescription
data.value: When you explicitly authorize sharing your information with specific parties.

data.name: RealEstatePartnersDescription
data.value: With trusted real estate agencies and professionals to facilitate property transactions.

data.name: LegalRequirementsDescription
data.value: When required by law, court order, or government regulation.

data.name: SecurityProtectionDescription
data.value: To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users or the public.

data.name: DataSecurityDescription
data.value: We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your personal information:

data.name: EncryptionDescription
data.value: All data is encrypted using industry-standard SSL/TLS protocols

data.name: SecureServersDescription
data.value: Data is stored on secure, monitored servers with regular backups

data.name: AccessControlDescription
data.value: Strict access controls and authentication for all data access

data.name: RegularAuditsDescription
data.value: Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments

data.name: YourRightsDescription
data.value: Under applicable data protection laws, you have the following rights:

data.name: RightToAccessDescription
data.value: Request a copy of your personal data and information about how we process it.

data.name: RightToRectificationDescription
data.value: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.

data.name: RightToErasureDescription
data.value: Request deletion of your personal data in certain circumstances.

data.name: RightToRestrictionDescription
data.value: Request limitation of processing in certain circumstances.

data.name: RightToPortabilityDescription
data.value: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

data.name: RightToObjectDescription
data.value: Object to processing of your data for certain purposes.
